title: Toledo Frog Mural
description: A vibrant, large-scale mural featuring colorful blue and green tree frogs painted on the side of a building in downtown Toledo.

title: All You Need Is Love
description: A colorful mural located at Peace Love Happiness World Headquarters in downtown Toledo.

title: River Gallery Studio
description: 500 Madison Avenue, Toledo, OH 43604

title: Glass City River Wall
description: The largest mural in North America, spanning 28 ADM grain silos across 170,000 sq ft along the Maumee River. Features sunflowers and portraits of Native American women and children honoring the region's first agriculturalists. Photo: Doug Hinebaugh.

title: Greetings from Toledo
description: A colorful postcard-style mural at 120 Main St in East Toledo, featuring iconic Toledo landmarks like Tony Packo's, the Skyway Bridge, and the Toledo Mud Hens. Photo: Doug Hinebaugh.

title: Toledo Museum of Art
description: World-class art museum with free admission, housed in a stunning Greek Revival building. Home to the renowned Glass Pavilion. 2445 Monroe St, Toledo, OH 43620. Photo: Doug Hinebaugh.

title: 20 North Gallery
description: Toledo's oldest independent art gallery, founded in 1993. Located in the historic Warehouse District at 18 N. St. Clair St, Toledo, OH 43604. Photo: Kenny Greene.

title: Collingwood Arts Center
description: A historic arts hub since 1905 offering artist studios, live performances, classes, and workshops. 2413 Collingwood Blvd, Toledo, OH 43620. Photo: Smithr1981, CC BY 3.0.

title: River House Arts
description: A full-service gallery in the historic Secor Building downtown, with free, ever-changing exhibitions.

title: Echo
description: Eleven rings from a former steam plant smokestack create a pathway through the landscape — a metaphor for Toledo's transition from past to present to future. Photo: Doug Hinebaugh.

title: Upon Reflection
description: Two suspended ovals — one mirrored, one backlit — play off sunlight by day and glow with LEDs by night. 310 N Summit St. Photo: Doug Hinebaugh.

title: Various Paintings by Dean Davis
description: A rotating collection of mixed-media paintings and works by Toledo muralist Dean Davis, displayed at The Loft 419. 336 N Superior St, Toledo, OH.

title: Ye Olde Cock & Bull
description: Hand-painted pub mural at Ye Olde Cock & Bull, 9 N Huron St, Toledo, OH 43604.

title: The Ageless Empress and Her Beloved Beings
description: A striking mural featuring a purple lion, a robed empress with flowing energy, monarch butterflies, and a misty landscape — a celebration of nature's power and grace.

title: St. Clair Street Garage Mural
description: A vibrant mural wrapping the entrance of a parking garage at 201 N St Clair St, featuring two figures flanking a central totem, a cityscape, rainbow, and abstract patterns across the columns and ceiling.

title: Tragic Mask
description: A monumental bronze mask sculpture by French artists Anne & Patrick Poirier, evoking the archetypal tragic mask of classical theater.

title: Various Works, Mark J. Bevington Collection
description: A rotating display of works from the Mark J. Bevington Collection, on view at Tolhouse. 1447 N Summit St, Toledo, OH 43604.

title: José Martínez Memorial Galería
description: 1222 Broadway, Toledo, OH 43609

title: There Is No Such Thing as a Wrong Note
description: Large outdoor mural featuring an acoustic guitar and a black-and-white portrait of a jazz musician, with the quote "There is no such thing as a wrong note." in handwritten white text.

title: Ostrich Skeleton
description: A wall-mounted sculpture of a skeletal flightless bird with stylized teal-and-blue ribs, displayed on the dark paneled exterior of the Ostrich Towne building.

title: Ostrich Towne Mural
description: A large mural of three life-sized brown ostriches striding across the brick side of the Ostrich Towne building, set against a swirling blue and orange sky.

title: Piano Bridge Mural
description: A mural of a piano keyboard arching like a suspension bridge, painted in blues and purples across a teal-and-blue brick wall.

title: Blue Lupine
description: Tall blue steel arches resembling trees, topped with luminous white and silver leaf-like forms, installed on the plaza outside the Glass City Center.

title: Floral Garden Mural
description: A large-scale floral mural wrapping a downtown plaza wall in oversized daisies, coneflowers and wildflowers, paired with a black granite reflecting trough holding a single white orb.

title: "Never a Wrong Note" Mural
description: A bold black-and-white typographic mural reading "NEVER A WRONG NOTE" across a downtown plaza wall.

title: Geometric Mural (Parking Structure)
description: A bold geometric mural of overlapping angular bands and diagonal stripes in red, blue, yellow, pink and teal on a downtown parking-structure wall.

title: Toledo Skyline Mural
description: A painted Toledo skyline set within a brick archway, with "TOLEDO" lettering and a small "Pride" script across the base.

title: Ostrich Heads Mural
description: A vivid mural of four stylized ostrich heads in saturated purples, pinks and oranges along the side of the Ostrich Towne building — a third ostrich-themed piece near the skeleton sculpture and the striding-ostriches mural.

title: "Toledo Loves Love" Mural
description: A rainbow-hued mural reading "TOLEDO LOVES LOVE" with abstract floral and linework forms across a brick wall.

title: Abstract Panel Mural
description: A long multi-panel mural of abstract geometric and figurative motifs — harlequin diamonds, a portrait in an oval, and bold maze-like patterns — along a building wall.

title: Heart-Glasses Portrait Mural
description: A portrait mural of a smiling woman with golden hair and pink heart-shaped sunglasses painted across a garage door. A signature reading "Scherer" is visible, but the artist is unconfirmed.

title: Cicada Mural
description: A large mural of an iridescent cicada with stained-glass-like wings on a coral ground, above a band of marbled blue-and-orange floral forms.

title: Single-Line Face Mural
description: A giant continuous-line drawing of a woman's face on a white wall, with tiny figures climbing ladders across it.

title: Toledo School for the Arts
description: Arts high school and community gallery (Maxine and Stuart Frankel Family Foundation Annex), home to rotating exhibits, a permanent lobby sculpture, and a donor wall.

exhibits.title: One City, Many Moments
exhibits.description: A photography exhibition by Doug Hinebaugh of Toledo skyline, riverfront and portrait work, including a backlit skyline print captioned "you will do better..." in neon.
